rawContent: The headline to this post I wrote, about a 14-year-old Black boy shot at for having the audacity to ring someone's doorbell & about two Black men arrested for lounging in a Starbucks, pretty much says it all. https://t.co/5cqYLBO3Co #2018Milestones #BlackLivesMatter
Add this to the too-fucking-long list of reasons why you need to stop pretending as if you don't know why athletes take a knee & why #BlackLivesMatter exists.
